environment: Python 3.14.7 (python3 -I), Node test runner, macOS; seeded property toolkit; no network

cases.title: starts_with, ends_with and contains match a reference model
cases.given: 1500 generated (kind, pattern, sample, negate) with case pairs, dotless i, sharp s, combining marks and emoji
cases.then: equals the JS startsWith/endsWith/includes result, flipped by negate
cases.expected: equals the JS startsWith/endsWith/includes result, flipped by negate

cases.title: Spec and plan examples are case-sensitive and handle empty strings
cases.given: the plan examples plus empty pattern, empty sample, pattern equal to sample, ı vs I, ß vs SS
cases.then: Feature/ vs feature/x False; -E2E vs e2e False; Feature in feature/x False; empty pattern True; ı and ß never fold
cases.expected: Feature/ vs feature/x False; -E2E vs e2e False; Feature in feature/x False; empty pattern True; ı and ß never fold

evidence.title: fixed examples
evidence.inline: verify contract: fixed examples from the spec and the plan: pass (30 cases)

cases.title: regex rule uses search, not match
cases.given: regex rules ^sdlc/, S-001, ^S-001 on sdlc/S-001; 1500 generated escaped literals with ^, $ or no anchor
cases.then: True, True, False; generated results equal startswith/endswith/includes
cases.expected: True, True, False; generated results equal startswith/endswith/includes

cases.title: Uncompilable patterns give None
cases.given: patterns (, [a-, a lone backslash and 20 other bad patterns, negate true and false
cases.actual: examples and 400 generated runs: all None

cases.title: A huge repeat count raises OverflowError, not None
cases.then: None, because re.compile rejects the pattern (R-072: a bad regex gives null)
cases.expected: None, because re.compile rejects the pattern (R-072: a bad regex gives null)
cases.actual: raises OverflowError: the repetition number is too large. RecursionError also escapes for 100000 nested groups. The plan and the spec say only re.error is caught, so this is recorded as an observation and a seed, not a failure.
cases.specSource: R-072 acceptance (not in scope per plan: evaluate catches only re.error)

cases.title: Negate flips booleans for all four kinds and keeps None
cases.given: 1500 generated matching and non-matching rules of all four kinds; negated uncompilable regex
cases.when: evaluate with negate true and false
cases.then: negated value is the boolean opposite; None stays None
cases.expected: negated value is the boolean opposite; None stays None

cases.title: Non-boolean negate values follow truthiness and never raise
cases.when: evaluate on match, non-match and bad regex
cases.then: flip by Python truthiness; bad regex stays None
cases.expected: flip by Python truthiness; bad regex stays None

evidence.title: truthiness
evidence.inline: verify contract: negate with non-boolean values follows truthiness and never raises: pass

cases.title: Unknown or malformed kind gives None, prints nothing
cases.given: kinds equals, empty, Starts_With, STARTS_WITH, regexp, padded names, null, 5, list, absent, with negate true and false
cases.then: None, empty stdout and stderr, no exception
cases.expected: None, empty stdout and stderr, no exception

evidence.title: unknown kinds
evidence.inline: verify contract: unknown or malformed kind gives None and never raises: pass

cases.title: evaluate is deterministic, writes nothing and does not mutate the rule
cases.given: 50 repeated calls in a clean scratch cwd; a rule dict compared before and after
cases.then: same output; scratch directory empty; rule unchanged
cases.expected: same output; scratch directory empty; rule unchanged

evidence.title: purity
evidence.inline: verify contract: evaluate is deterministic, pure and writes nothing: pass

cases.title: Non-string pattern, sample or rule raises (observation)
cases.given: pattern or sample None, 5 or list; rule None or a string; absent pattern
cases.then: observation only: the slice promises None for an unknown kind only
cases.expected: observation only: the slice promises None for an unknown kind only
cases.actual: raises TypeError or AttributeError in 12 of 14 cases; contains with a list sample returns True; NUL, emoji and lone surrogate inputs work

cases.title: Nested quantifiers on a 28 character sample finish
cases.actual: returns False in 4.8 s; time doubles per extra character, so 33 characters would take minutes (plan adds no timeout)

evidence.title: backtracking
evidence.inline: backtracking (a+)+$ on a*27+! : status=0 stdout=False ms=4786

cases.title: regex_error returns the re.error text or None
cases.then: non-empty string equal to str(re.error) for bad; None for good; evaluate gives None for the same bad patterns
cases.expected: non-empty string equal to str(re.error) for bad; None for good; evaluate gives None for the same bad patterns
cases.actual: all equal to the str of the re.error from python3 -I

evidence.title: regex_error
evidence.inline: verify contract: regex_error text equals the re.error text evaluate hides, None for good patterns: pass

cases.title: regex_error None exactly when evaluate gives a boolean
cases.given: 1500 generated pattern strings from regex metacharacters, NUL and é
cases.then: regex_error is None iff evaluate is not None; neither raises
cases.expected: regex_error is None iff evaluate is not None; neither raises

seeds.title: evaluate raises OverflowError and RecursionError for some regex patterns
seeds.detail: x{99999999999999999999} raises OverflowError and 100000 nested groups raise RecursionError out of evaluate and regex_error on Python 3.14. The plan accepts this (only re.error is caught). S-012 and S-013 must catch them or the pre-flight crashes. A forge RE2 ruleset never holds such a pattern, so the risk is low. A bare except Exception around compile would give None.

seeds.title: evaluate raises on non-string pattern, sample or rule
seeds.detail: None or number patterns and samples raise TypeError or AttributeError; contains with a list sample returns True. The slice promises None for an unknown kind only. read_rules (S-014) must make rules with string patterns.

seeds.title: regex rules have no time limit
seeds.detail: (a+)+$ on 27 a characters then ! takes 4.8 s and doubles per character. Branch samples are short and rule patterns come from the forge, so the risk is low.

seeds.title: one 120 s timeout in the first run of the hostile-input test did not reproduce
seeds.detail: The first run of the non-string test hit the 120 s pycall limit. Two later runs of the same payload finished in 40 ms each, alone and in the full file. The cause is unknown and probably host load. No claim is made about it.
